mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 58 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Prairie County Park, and the moon is currently in a waxing gibbous phase.

The I Voted sticker contest for students in grades K-12 has closed for submissions. The community will have the chance to vote on the winning designs starting July 28 through August 7, with the selected art appearing on stickers for the November election.
We have a busy lineup starting today with live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol tomorrow.
Looking at the weekly report, on July 13, a driver was arrested for an O-W-I after their vehicle became stuck on a rock while others attempted to help dislodge it.
Today's flavor is the delicious Chocolate Volcano. Culver's is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM, and you can look forward to Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough tomorrow.
